title: "That X-point gap is the edge" contradicts the EV % shown next to it
expected: Edge number in text matches the EV/edge on the card
actual: Text: "83%... we make it 85%. That 2.6-point gap is the edge" while card says EV +3.2% (CBB: 4.9-point gap vs +7.3%). Two different "edge" numbers; rounded 83/85 looks like a 2-point gap.
